name: FlowBoard
description: Project workspaces, dashboard, and project-context hook for OpenClaw agents.

dashboardPort.description: Optional dashboard port the project-context hook uses when dashboardBaseUrl is not set (default 18700).

dashboardBaseUrl.description: Optional dashboard API base URL for the project-context hook, for example http://localhost:18843.

serviceToken.description: Service credential shared with the dashboard (FLOWBOARD_SERVICE_TOKEN). Lets the Gateway act for the signed-in operator. Accepts a SecretRef ({ source, provider, id }); prefer it over an inline string.

projectsDir.label: Projects Directory
projectsDir.help: Optional path for FlowBoard project files. Prefer the FLOWBOARD_PROJECTS_DIR environment variable for service deployments.

dashboardPort.label: Dashboard Port
dashboardPort.help: Optional local dashboard port for the project-context hook when the service does not run on the default 18700 (for example an install that kept the previous default 18790).

dashboardBaseUrl.label: Dashboard Base URL
dashboardBaseUrl.help: Optional full base URL for the project-context hook. Prefer this for proxy, tunnel, or non-localhost setups.

serviceToken.label: Service Token
serviceToken.help: Shared credential the Gateway sends to the dashboard (FLOWBOARD_SERVICE_TOKEN, at least 32 characters). Store it as a SecretRef; it lets the Gateway act for the signed-in operator on loopback.
